SlideMate 0.3 adds flashcards, pictures in the chat, and updates that install themselves.

### New
- **Automatic updates**: SlideMate checks GitHub once a day and offers **Install and Relaunch** when a new version is
  out. You can also choose SlideMate → **Check for Updates…**. This is the last update you need to download by hand.
- **Flashcards**: active-recall cards for every lecture, scheduled with FSRS (like Anki), focused on what was hard.
- **Pictures in the chat**: drag them from Finder, paste them, or use the paperclip, so the tutor can read your
  handwritten notes.
- **Snip the chat too**: drag over the chat or lecture notes and Send to iPad.
- **Import timed transcripts** (e.g. Re/Play captions) as lecture notes. If a recording was only partial, it fills in
  just the slides that were missed.
- **Recording time limit** (default 2 h, Settings → Lecture recording) with a 5-minute heads-up.
- **The chat follows the slide you're on**: "All slides" is a temporary view that switches back when you move on.

### Fixes
- Long recordings are transcribed in 15-minute pieces, so memory stays low; only one transcription runs at a time, and
  **Try again** re-transcribes a transcript that never finished.
- SlideMate notices when the microphone stops (unplugged, recorder error, no audio for 45 s) and finishes the lecture
  with what it captured.
- Slide tracking after switching to a shorter deck; recordings whose page went away are finished properly; ⌘R asks
  first while recording.
- Slides refit live while you drag panels or resize the window. Fit no longer leaves big side margins.
- The slide preview popup no longer gets stuck in the top-left corner.
- Library scans skip hidden and junk folders (.venv, .git, node_modules), which can make them hundreds of times faster.
- No horizontal scrollbar in the ask box when text is zoomed.

### Install
1. Download **SlideMate-0.3.0-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications (replace the old one).
   It's a universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13+.
2. First open: macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. macOS 13–14: right-click →
   **Open**. The app isn't notarised yet. Later updates install from inside the app.
3. Make sure Claude Code (`claude auth login`) or Codex (`codex login`) is installed and signed in. The setup
   screen walks you through the rest.

Prefer building from source? `git clone https://github.com/Mattlo0546/slidemate && cd slidemate && scripts/install.sh`
